fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name as in service records. UPS is effective from April 1, 2025 for central government employees. It assures 50% of last 12 months average basic pay as pension after 25 years.
fields.instruction_hi: Seva records mein darz poora naam likhein. UPS 1 April 2025 se kendriya sarkari karamchariyon ke liye laagu hai. 25 saal baad antim 12 mahine ki average basic pay ka 50% pension milega.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your government employee ID. UPS gives assured pension, assured family pension (60% of employee pension), and assured minimum pension of Rs 10,000/month after 10 years.
fields.instruction_hi: Sarkari karamchari ID likhein. UPS nishchit pension, nishchit parivarik pension (karamchari pension ka 60%), aur 10 saal baad 10,000 rupaye/maah ki nyuntam pension deta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your joining date in government service. Under UPS, minimum 10 years of service gives proportional pension. Full pension requires 25 years of service.
fields.instruction_hi: Sarkari seva mein joining tithi likhein. UPS ke tahat minimum 10 saal ki seva se anupaarik pension milti hai. Poori pension ke liye 25 saal ki seva zaruri hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your Ministry or Department name. Your department's nodal office will process your UPS registration and manage pension contributions.
fields.instruction_hi: Apne Mantralaya ya Vibhag ka naam likhein. Aapke vibhag ka nodal karyalay UPS registration process karega aur pension yogdan manage karega.

fields.instruction_en: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar for identity verification and pension account linking.
fields.instruction_hi: Pahchaan verification aur pension account linking ke liye 12 ank ka Aadhaar likhein.
